In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires

KHYBER PAHHTUNKHWA PROHIBITION OF DANCING ACT, 1974
KHYBER PAHHTUNKHWA PROHIBITION OF DANCING ACT, 1974
(ACT NO. IV OF 1974)
[Gazette of [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa] Extraordinary, 5th July, 1974]
[5th July, 1974]
An Act to prohibit dancing in the [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]
2. In this Act, unless the context otherwise
requires, the following expressions shall have the meaning hereby
respectively assigned to them, that is to say--
(a) "dance" with all its grammatical variations shall mean
the dance performed for money consideration or reward;
(b)
"Government" means the Government of the 14[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa];
(c) "public
place" includes any house, room, tent, enclosure, road, lane, bridge,
square or any other place to which the public are admitted to witness a defence on payment of money or otherwise.
14. Subs. by the Constitution (18th Amdt.)
Act, (X of 2010) for the word N.W.F.P. .

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pahhtunkhwa Prohibition of Dancing Act 1974
sections.description:
Penalty for dancing in a public place

KHYBER PAHHTUNKHWA PROHIBITION OF DANCING ACT, 1974
KHYBER PAHHTUNKHWA PROHIBITION OF DANCING ACT, 1974
(ACT NO. IV OF 1974)
[Gazette of [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa] Extraordinary, 5th July, 1974]
[5th July, 1974]
An Act to prohibit dancing in the [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]
3. Penalty for dancing in a public place.--(1) Dancing by a woman
in a public place shall be an offence.
(2) Any woman found guilty of an
offence under this Act shall be punished with fine may extend to 15[tow thousand rupees],.
(3) Any woman, having been
conceived of an offence under this Act again commits an offence under this Act
shall be punished for every such subsequent offence with simple imprisonment
which may extend to 16[three months]
or with fine which may extend to 17[four
thousand rupees], or with both.

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pahhtunkhwa Prohibition of Dancing Act 1974
sections.description:
Power to enter and arrest

KHYBER PAHHTUNKHWA PROHIBITION OF DANCING ACT, 1974
KHYBER PAHHTUNKHWA PROHIBITION OF DANCING ACT, 1974
(ACT NO. IV OF 1974)
[Gazette of [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa] Extraordinary, 5th July, 1974]
[5th July, 1974]
An Act to prohibit dancing in the [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]
4. Power to enter and arrest.--(1) If a District Magistrate,
Officer not below the rank of an Inspector Magistrate of the First Class or any
Police Officer not below the rank of an Inspector has reason to believe that
any offence under this Act has been, is being or is about to be committed, he may
enter any public place and arrest any woman who, his opinion, has committed, is
committing or is about to commit such offence.
(2) It shall be the duty of the
officer arresting any woman under sub-section (1) to make a report of the
circumstances under which the arrest was made to the nearest Police Station and
to release such woman on bail if sufficient bail be tendered for her appearance
before Police Officer or before a Magistrate, as the case may be.
(3) When any woman is arrested
under sub-section (1), the person arresting her shall, if sufficient bail is
not tendered, send her to the nearest Police Station, with a report of the
circumstances under which such arrest was made.

Cognizance of offence

KHYBER PAHHTUNKHWA PROHIBITION OF DANCING ACT, 1974
KHYBER PAHHTUNKHWA PROHIBITION OF DANCING ACT, 1974
(ACT NO. IV OF 1974)
[Gazette of [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa] Extraordinary, 5th July, 1974]
[5th July, 1974]
An Act to prohibit dancing in the [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]
5. Cognizance of offence.--No Court shall take cognizance of any
offence under this Act except on the complaint in writing made by an Inspector
of Police of the area in whose jurisdiction the offence is alleged to have been
committed.
